metadata.question: Were there more than 8 active fires in the Sakha Republic on August 6, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) or MODIS/VIIRS active fire products - Date: August 6, 2020 (single day) - Location: Sakha Republic (Yakutia), Russia - need to define this geometry 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for fire detection products - Fire products already provide confidence levels - may want to filter by confidence 3. Logic to distinguish cases: - Valid Zero (B): Collection has data, but count ≤ 8 fires - Yes (A): Count > 8 fires - C1: No images/data available for this date/location - C2: Images exist but no valid fire pixels after filtering - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN 4. Approach: - Use FIRMS MODIS or VIIRS active fire data - Filter by date and Sakha Republic boundary - Count fire detections - Compare to threshold of 8 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Sakha Republic (Yakutia) approximate bounds const sakha = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[105, 55], [165, 55], [165, 73], [105, 73], [105, 55]] ]); const startDate = '2020-08-06'; const endDate = '2020-08-07'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Try FIRMS MODIS first let fireCol = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(sakha); let colSize = fireCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`FIRMS collection size: ${colSize}`); // If FIRMS not available, try MODIS Thermal Anomalies if (colSize === 0) { fireCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(sakha); colSize = fireCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS MOD14A1 collection size: ${colSize}`); } // If still no data, try VIIRS if (colSize === 0) { fireCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/VNP14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(sakha); colSize = fireCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`VIIRS VNP14A1 collection size: ${colSize}`); } if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No fire data available for August 6, 2020 in Sakha Republic.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Use MOD14A1 (daily fire product) const fireImage = fireCol.first(); const fireMask = fireImage.select('FireMask'); // FireMask: values 7-9 indicate fire pixels // 7 = low confidence, 8 = nominal confidence, 9 = high confidence const firePixels = fireMask.gte(7).and(fireMask.lte(9)); // 4. Count fire pixels const fireStats = firePixels.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sakha, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const fireCount = fireStats.get('FireMask').getInfo(); if (fireCount === null || fireCount === undefined) { console.log('Fire count calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Active fire pixels detected: ${fireCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (fireCount === 0) { console.log('No valid fire pixels found.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (fireCount > 8) { console.log(`Yes, ${fireCount} fires detected (> 8).`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`No, only ${fireCount} fires detected (<= 8).`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
